messages:
samir: Quick thread to lock the pilot onboarding + rollout checklist for Optimize Toolkit. I want an operationally-light path so we can spin two pilots in 2 weeks.

jia: Outline please — I'm thinking signup flow, consent modal, small canary, and telemetry tags.

samir: Exactly. Draft plan below; pls flag gaps.

noah: +1. Also call out explicit billing/compute consent for hosted profiling. Legal wants the wording up-front.

samir: Pilot onboarding checklist (draft):
- Signup + opt-in: customer toggles "Optimize toolkit pilot" per-org. Show short blurb + link to privacy blurb.
- Consent modal: before any hosted profiling run show estimated tokens, estimated cost, and residency option (hosted / VPC). Example copy: `This profiling run will sample ~500 requests, estimated cost $X. Start?`
- Prompt suite upload: customers upload prompt suites to either our intake UI (hosted) or provide a VPC S3 URI.
- Canary rollout: start with 5% traffic sample for advisory recs, 1 model at a time.
- Telemetry tags: add tags `optimize.pilot=true`, `pilot.customer=<org>`, `profile.run.id=<id>` to all related events.
- Alert routing: pilot alerts go to console + webhook + a dedicated #pilot-alerts slack channel (ops+customer).
- Experiment buckets: advisory-only vs advisory+auto-suggest (no auto-apply in pilot).

pat: For canary, let's define clear success/failure criteria: success = no customer-visible regression and precision >= 0.8 on labeled set; failure = any customer-reported regression or >5% unexpected false-positive flood in 24h.

jia: Also add a small cost-safety: abort profiling if cost > 3x estimate or > $500 per run (customer-visible).

noah: Ops notes: implement `--dry-run` profiler flag for hosted runs that simulates costs without storing results, useful for legal/demo.

legal-bot: Legal asks: host prompt suites only with signed data-use agreement. Provide templated clause: "Redacted samples only; full context accessible via customer storage and only retrieved with additional consent."

samir: Good catch. I'll add GA checkboxes: legal-signed, residency chosen, and billing-consent checked. Pilot cannot start without them.

pat: Add rollback playbook snippet:
```
1) Detect regression or customer report.
2) Pause any scheduled profiling runs for that customer.
3) Revert to previous model config (manual) and notify customer.
4) Postmortem email template + 48h follow-up.
```

jia: UI microcopy: keep the diff view short — two sample outputs with "quality delta" % and a compact histogram for latency. Add buttons: `Mark as OK` / `Request Follow-up`.

samir: Action items: 
- @noah: implement telemetry tags + dry-run flag by Fri.
- @jia: mockup consent modal + compact diff UI by Thu.
- @pat: write rollback playbook + postmortem template.
- @legal-bot: attach data-use template and confirm required checkbox text.

ops-bot: reminder set for 2966740000: "Pilot onboarding artifacts due" :bell:

samir: If we can get these in the initiative doc by Monday we'll start customer outreach. Thanks.
